calibration_target: exit_at_average ('Выход по средней цене'): whole bag closes flat when price reaches avg_entry × (1 ± target_pct) — NOT the bare average. CORRECTED + VERIFIED from a live BTC bot stat.extension (Mac, 2026-07-18): avgPL 63941.79→tapb 64242.32 = +0.470%, avgPS 63040.89→taps 62744.60 = −0.470%, at tog=0.47 — exact match. This mechanically EXPLAINS the cliff: higher target pushes the flush level further from the average, so at high target the bag can never reach it → hangs. closeReason=1 = BATCH flush of the whole bag (Mac verified on 3753 orders: 78-99% of closes batch on exit-ON bots vs 61-74% individual on OFF bots), NOT a per-order take. tools/_grid_sim.py (Jun-8) does NOT model this.
precision_note: realized_pnl_usd is exact (to cents) where captured from the latest batch; older points were rounded to whole USD in Win memory (marked precision=rounded). transient_bag_low_usd is operator-reported approximate, not per-run isolated. Volume 'null' = not transcribed for that run.
provenance_caveat: GinArea is amnesiac (no export, no history). These screenshots are the ONLY surviving record of these runs. Transcribed by Win from operator screenshots; not cross-checked vs GinArea API. Small risk of ID/PnL typos — verify against originals before decision-grade use.
